RFP Persona runtime and source notices

Runtime: @rive-app/react-webgl2 4.38.0 (MIT), which depends on
@rive-app/webgl2 2.48.0 (MIT). The two WASM files in 2.48.0/ are copied
without modification from that exact npm package. Both the primary and
architecture fallback runtime are served by this application; no runtime
WASM CDN fallback is configured. Runtime license notices are included here.

RfpPersona.tsx adapts the state-machine and default-view-model integration
from Vercel AI Elements Persona (Apache-2.0):
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vercel/ai-elements/main/packages/elements/src/persona.tsx
https://elements.ai-sdk.dev/components/persona
Copyright 2023 Vercel, Inc. See LICENSE-ai-elements.txt.
Changes: Halo-only interface, local WASM, lifecycle/failure handling,
reduced-motion fallback, paused playback, and the app's existing light theme.

The animation itself is loaded directly from the exact official sample URL:
https://ejiidnob33g9ap1r.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/halo-2.0.riv
No .riv binary is stored or redistributed in this repository. That request
contains no application text, documents, model inputs, or API keys. An external
asset outage produces the static AI fallback and does not affect job status.

The repository's code license does not establish a separate redistribution
license for the externally hosted animation. Upstream clarification remains
open at https://github.com/vercel/ai-elements/issues/471 . Do not describe the
Halo binary as locally licensed Apache-2.0 or copy it into a distributed bundle
on the strength of the source-code license alone.

Runtime originals:
https://github.com/rive-app/rive-react
https://github.com/rive-app/rive-wasm
